commands.name: wear
commands.description: Restyle Claude Code: list themes, or wear one, auto, pin or unpin

children: Wearing Claude Code's own look everywhere without a pin.
Monochrome ink; status told apart by shape alone
Light, warm and quiet, for bright rooms
Cool blues and neon, after the Tokyo Night palette
Purple, pink and green on deep slate
Solarized dark, nudged brighter to pass contrast
Arctic frost blues, after the Nord palette
WCAG AAA: at least 7:1 contrast on everything it draws
Diffs in blue and orange, icons that differ by shape
Pumpkin orange, violet and bone white on near-black
Holly green, berry red, snow white and gold on deep pine
Fresh green, blossom pink and sky blue on cream
Sun yellow, sea teal and coral on deep navy
Amber, rust, moss and cream on dark brown
by the calendar: autumn now (Sep 1 to Nov 30, Halloween aside)
/wear <theme> switches now. /wear auto follows the clock, /wear season the calendar. /wear pin keeps this look for this project; /wear unpin lets go.
